fields.statement: QA claude-code-7a553445 at 2aa167c9 with a scratch build (go build -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza) in a hermetic HOME and Rhiza root: rhiza init, a change set with leaf alpha, a code workflow (wait gate then command step rhiza run code-check), rhiza run start --foreground. In the run worktree a builder commit (Leaf: alpha) and verifier Evidence; baseline code-check passed. (a) Committed on the run branch a real log entry with v=5 (FormatVersion+1, id matching its file name): plain rhiza check exits 1 'fail log ...: entry: newer format: field "v": 5, this Rhiza reads 4'; rhiza run code-check exits 0 'code-check passed', and --json lists it under rule log at severity warn. (c) A branch-added corrupt (invalid JSON) entry: code-check exits 1 with cause 'rhiza check: fail log ... invalid JSON'. (b) The same v5 entry committed on main and merged into the branch, so it is at the merge-base: code-check exits 1 with cause 'rhiza check: fail log ... newer format', while the branch-added v5 entry still only warns. Then, with only the branch-added v5 entry, released the gate and rhiza run resume --foreground: step code passes and the run succeeds. Scoped tests: go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run TestCheck ok, ./internal/check/... ok, cmd/rhiza TestScripts/(review-code-check|describe-golden) ok (with GOTMPDIR outside the repo).
